description: Serves "Build a site for <event>", "make an event website" and "start a site from <url>" (the url gives layout only), not the host's own page tools. Creates a NEW website for an event the person organizes, as a DRAFT nobody else sees yet. `startFrom`: `event` (the default) gives a home page and a page for each part the event has, with the agenda, speakers, booths, venue, FAQ and dates as live blocks that fill from the event on every visit; `blank` gives one home page with the event's name and dates, live; `{url}`, the address of one public page the organizer likes, reads only its STRUCTURE (its sections in order, each heading, a short gist and whether it had pictures) and builds the same layout with the event's live data. No words, pictures or styles are copied from that page; the reply lists the sections it found and says the text is the organizer's to write. `title` names the site. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, and nothing is created. Read it back to the organizer; only when they say yes, call again with the same `title` and `startFrom`, `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. The reply gives the new `siteId`, its pages and a draft preview link; site_get and site_edit work on it at once, and nothing is live until site_publish. An event holds at most 20 sites. Only the organizer of the event can create one; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It needs a personal connector token. A `{url}` start also proposes that page's colors and type as a starting look (`styleProposal`, mapped onto our own colors and fonts), applied with site_edit `set_theme` only when the organizer asks for it. Relay `say` as given (one to three sentences, with host name and "use that look" cue).

changeId.description: The preview id; required with confirm.

confirm.description: Absent previews only; true creates the previewed site.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

url.description: The address of one public web page.

name: site_create
title: Create an event website (organizers only)
